attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his own essay.

semantics.note: Retrospective observation with the knowledge qualifier kept. 'As far as I know' limits what he claims to know. It is not a probability hedge, so the claim stays a scorable observation.

contract.note: Reading 'replace' as job displacement rather than automating tasks is the ordinary reading and fair. Support requires broad evidence that zero replacements occurred, a high bar the packet cannot meet.

evidence.note: Aggregate US Medicare-enrolled radiologist growth, 2014–2023. Total headcount cannot show whether any individual job was displaced by AI.
Developer's own account of autonomously reporting normal chest X-rays. This automates tasks; it names no eliminated radiologist job.

reviews.rationale: No documented case of AI replacing a radiologist appears, and headcount grew. But the packet itself says there is no comprehensive record of zero displacement, which the support condition requires. Task automation (e2) does not meet the contradiction condition. The evidence settles neither side.

attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his own essay.

semantics.note: Firm 'will' with no deadline, so a scorable forecast. The analogy is kept as illustration, not a measured benchmark.

contract.note: Reading 'plenty of leverage' as substantial practical help to human-led science is ordinary and fair. Not limiting it to 2026–27 models matches this sentence's own wording.

evidence.note: 2026 survey of 637 researchers: about three quarters report time savings averaging nearly 7 hours a week, plus higher output. Gains are self-reported.
2025 preprint: researchers used genome language models to design 16 viable phages that worked in experiments. A concrete human-led research result.
Same study's limitations: results are associations, not causation; verification burden and lab bottlenecks. This qualifies the size of the gains but does not show there were none.

reviews.rationale: The early-resolution rule is met before the evaluation date. Post-publication workflow evidence (e1) and a concrete experimental result (e2) document substantial practical gains across several human-led uses. The limits in e3 temper the magnitude but do not meet the contradiction condition.

attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his own essay.

semantics.note: 'Highly doubt' expresses high confidence that it will not happen, so it is a scored forecast, not a graded hedge. 'Highly unlikely' keeps that strength. 'On their own' and 'next few years' are preserved.

contract.note: The deadline of end-2028 for 'next few years' and the autonomy and recognition tests are reasonable ordinary readings. Only a contradiction can resolve it early.

evidence.note: Anthropic's account of its own work: humans did all lab work and gave initial direction. Neither autonomy nor Nobel-level significance is shown, so this does not contradict.

reviews.rationale: The working deadline (2028-12-31) falls after the evaluation date. The only candidate (e1) keeps substantive human involvement and lacks independent recognition as Nobel-level work, so the early contradiction rule is not met. Continued absence cannot support the forecast early.

attribution.note: Marcus's own judgment of a promise Musk made. The quoted promise is Musk's, but the assessment of it is Marcus's claim.

semantics.note: 'Hasn't fared much better' reasonably means the promise stayed largely unfulfilled. The comparison with radiology is loose, and the drafter rightly does not make it exact.

contract.note: Fair plain reading: robotaxis must be autonomous, the deadline is 2020, and the period runs to publication. The jurisdiction caveat is handled correctly.

evidence.note: Tesla's own January 2025 10-K. The driver must remain engaged, and the robotaxi business is only 'intended' to begin in 2025. It is a company filing, but an admission against interest that no autonomous robotaxi fleet existed.

reviews.rationale: As of January 2025, Tesla's own filing said its robotaxi business had not launched and that its driver-assistance software still required an engaged driver. So the promise of a million-plus robotaxis by 2020 remained substantially unfulfilled through March 2025, as Marcus said.
